description: A script for generating and updating a changelog file using git-cliff, including functions for running git-cliff, ensuring changelog markers, removing existing entries, building changelog content, and updating the changelog file.

methods.name: run_git_cliff
methods.description: Invokes git-cliff with specified version and returns the release notes.

methods.name: ensure_marker
methods.description: Checks for the changelog marker in text and splits the content.

methods.name: remove_existing_entry
methods.description: Removes existing changelog entries for a specific version.

methods.name: build_changelog
methods.description: Constructs the new changelog content with prefix, entry, and suffix.

methods.name: update_changelog
methods.description: Updates the CHANGELOG.md file with new release notes, optionally in dry-run mode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, generate release notes, and update changelog.
